narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Spread flat on the floor, the top view comes out longer than the stick itself.
<bookmark mark='drop'/>The top view keeps along and deep, but the up direction is lost.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Losing a direction can only make a view shorter, or leave it equal.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows the top view is longer; the top view drops the up direction and is laid beside the stick, shorter; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, measure each view and square it. None should beat the square of the line.
<bookmark mark='last'/>Then add the three squares. You should get twice the square of the line.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stick and its views sit together; the lines no view longer than the line and squares add to twice appear

old_misconception.wrong_answer: the top view comes out longer than the stick itself
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says the top view comes out longer than the stick itself, because it is spread flat. Each view drops one direction of travel, so it can only be shorter or equal.
